lead: `gaps.py` ranks a class by case count, not by question, so a handoff item derived from it can name work already on disk.
body: A counted sweep over `Core\Cli\Style::of`'s axes was already `cli-a-styles-seven-slots-are-independent.nvst`, inside the very count that ranked the member thin. The case titles say which question each asks and are one `ls tests/conformance/core | grep -i <class>` away; do that first, and when the item is landed say so in the handoff rather than writing a second case asking the same thing.
